qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive transmission and distribution franchise monopoly in the Greater Houston metro area. Regulated rate-base model with approved cost-recovery riders (TCRF, DCRF) and storm securitization bonds, though regulated returns limit ROIC to ~5.7%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric T&D monopoly in Greater Houston and gas LDC network. However, immense capital intensity ($4.87B capex vs $2.49B OCF) drives negative free cash flow (-$2.38B), extreme debt load ($20.6B long-term debt, 19.6x net income, 2.34x interest coverage), and continuous reliance on capital markets and securitization debt.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC is 5.7%. FY2025 capex of $4,870M far exceeds operating cash flow of $2,486M, producing -$2.38B in negative FCF. Long-term debt reached $20,566M against net income of $1,052M (19.6x). EBIT of $2,110M vs interest of $903M yields 2.34x coverage, failing the 5.0x peace-of-mind test.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
